newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Distrigas slams draft EU gas directive.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Distrigas slams draft EU gas directive.

text.p: Belgian natural gas distributor Distrigas on Tuesday criticised the draft European Union directive on the gas market liberalisation as being too advantageous for producers.

"The... draft directive in its current form does not create a level playing field between companies that are active on the gas market," Distrigas Chief Executive Officer Jean-Pierre Depaemelaere told the annual shareholders meeting.
He said companies such as Distrigas were unable to access production infrastructure, storage or transport networks. In addition producers did not have to reveal their cost structure.
"So we find ourselves in a situation in which the natural dominance of producers is being increased," he said.
"Producing EU member states and countries from outside the EU can continue to possess their gas reserves, storage and offshore lines, and moreover, their price and export policy," he added.
